rule_of_this_file: Frozen before any gate of this protocol is trained and before any development score of one. Changes only by a dated amendment appended to 'amendments', made before the scores it could affect.
owner: 2026-10-23 13:34Z: "Let's queue agents to skip output layer, make a pr. Trial the two level output. And retrain for a coarser frame step"
problem: 62-66% of the VOCR5 models' CTC frames are blank on development dialogue, and the output head (96 -> 4,987 / 5,631 classes) is 29-40% of Small's and Normal's per-frame time (text-stats, #117 item 1). A tiny gate on the head's 96-wide input can say 'blank' before the head runs, so the head is skipped there.
known_before_freezing: text-stats-gate (#117; $HERD/shared/artifacts/text-stats-gate/section.md, results.json): on the development sample's tv + dn crops, a float 96 -> 16 -> 1 MLP fit on training-side GRAD-crop frames, target W8I argmax == blank, threshold eps = 1e-3 on a training-side calibration split, skipped 59.6 / 56.8 / 55.8% of dialogue frames (S / N / L) with greedy and Rubi-LM dialogue CER free (CI upper bound <= +0.05 points). That operating point (MLP, m = 0, eps = 1e-3) was picked by text-stats-gate after seeing those tv + dn results, so tv + dn here are a confirmation on the same data (optimistic).

Not seen by anyone yet: the int8 gate of this protocol, its exact (C-equal) threshold, the whole-dialogue cohort wd, the VOCR5 development score as a whole, Rubi's counter re-decode on gated top-K, Rubi's confidence cascade with gated models, the synthetic counter set with the gate, and any timing of a gated runtime.

models.what: the released VOCR5 recognizers (v0.3.0), frozen; only a gate is added

gate.shape: per tier: 96 -> 16 (ReLU) -> 1 on the head's input as the W8I head sees it (each frame's 96 floats quantised to int16 by vocr.c's quant16, scale max|x| / 32767)
gate.layer1: int8 weights with one float32 scale per hidden unit (symmetric max-abs, train/export.quantize_rows), float32 bias, through vocr.c's mm_i16 (exact int32 sums), ReLU
gate.layer2: float32: s = b2, then s = s + w2[j] * h[j] for j = 0..15 in order, each product and sum rounded (-ffp-contract=off)
gate.decision: a frame's head is skipped iff s > t (float32 t, stored with the gate)
gate.skipped_frame: argmax 0 (blank), its blank logit computed exactly as the head computes class 0 (the head's first 8-class block through mm_i16), top-K [blank logit, -inf, ...] (classes 0); the frame never emits a character
gate.storage: a versioned section appended to the unchanged version-1 blob (magic VOCG, its own version, size and CRC-32, bound to the base blob's byte count and CRC); a runtime without gate support reads the blob as before, and a blob without the section runs exactly as today
gate.runtime_switch: vocr_opts.head_gate (0 = off, the default: bit for bit today's output, arena and code path); 1 needs VOCR_MODE_W8I and a blob with the section; a run that asks for full logits (vocr_extra.logits) is never gated

training.data: the console-cut crops of VOCR5's own fine-tune pools (eval/vocr5_ft_sources.json 'owg' and 'ntg', pinned in eval/vocr5_pools.sha256): GRAD crops and their refined copies, as stored (console polarity), every row (dialogue and names)
training.hygiene: no row of a VN in eval/manifests/reserved.json 'test' or 'dev_sample' (asserted before any feature is extracted); the frames are the frozen model's own, so no text label is used
training.features: per frame, the head's input from the C runtime (vocr_extra.head_in, W8I), and the label y = (the W8I argmax is the blank), from the same run
training.split: by VN: sha1(vn) % 5 == 0 is the calibration split (the threshold), the rest the fit split
training.fit: PyTorch (requirements.lock), float32, inputs standardised with the fit split's mean and standard deviation; Linear(96, 16), ReLU, Linear(16, 1); BCEWithLogits on y; Adam lr 3e-3, cosine schedule over 12 epochs of batches of 4,096, seed 0; one fit per tier, nothing chosen among fits
training.export: the standardisation folded into layer 1 (w / sd, b - w . (mu / sd)), layer 1 quantised to int8 per hidden unit; layer 2 and the biases float32
training.threshold: on the calibration split, the exact scores of the exported gate (the Python twin, equal to the C runtime bit for bit) over the frames whose W8I argmax is not the blank: with n such frames and eps = 1e-3, t = the (floor(eps n) + 1)-th largest of their scores, so at most floor(eps n) of them are skipped
training.fallback: if a tier's gate fails the development rule below at eps = 1e-3, the same fit with eps = 1e-4 is exported and scored once for that tier, reported as the fallback; no other setting is tried

development.cohorts: exactly eval/vocr5_protocol.json 'cohorts' (the fixed development sample): tv = teacher_val_dev.npz (both views: rv as stored, console polarity; rvn screen polarity), dn = devnative's four *_dev.npz files (both views), wd = tv_dlg + dn_dlg whole-dialogue regions at base, +4 and +8 px through the C GRAD finder (flags 0) and with the C refinement (VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT), each line read with its dark flag as VOCR_INVERT
development.score: eval/vocr5_protocol.json 'score', dialogue only: dev score = 0.25 tv + 0.25 dn + 0.5 wd in CER points (eval/vocr5_select.py); names a secondary column
development.arms: per tier: 'today' (no gate) and 'gated' (vocr_opts.head_gate = 1 on the gated blob), C runtime W8I, max width 1024, default tile 4 and head batch 16

decodes.rubi: Rubi's line path (core/vocr_ocr.c finish_line, game_ocr/main.c policy): top-8 extras; vocr_post_redecode with {tau 6000, open 4000}; vocr_lm_decode with vocr_lm_o3_1000k.vlm (sha256 993000611555171daf6361e29a503b0871a5f3dd240a19555d55f16aaa3ab3d9; beam 8, top-K 8, alpha 500, beta 3500, gate 8000, VOCR_LM_EOS, bracket 8000), a line read as empty staying empty; then the counter rule vocr_post_counters (Rubi's core/textnorm.c mirrors it)
decodes.rubi_cascade: as rubi, and a line whose confidence (round(conf_min x 1000 + 0.5), 1000 for an empty greedy line) is below 700 (VJO_VOCR_CASCADE_CONF) is read again by the next tier up (S -> N, N -> L; Large has none, so its rubi_cascade is its rubi) with the same steps, and that reading replaces it; the cascade's time ceiling is not modelled (every such line is read again). In the gated arm the cascade's model runs gated too

development.bootstrap: eval/vocr5_select.py compare: VN-cluster bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, tv / dn / wd resampled independently with seeds 0 / 1 / 2, a replicate's score difference 0.25 tv + 0.25 dn + 0.5 wd; gated - today in points

rule.per_tier: the gate of a tier is ADOPTED (recommended on in Rubi) iff, for each of the three decodes, (a) the dev-score difference gated - today is not resolved worse: its 95% interval does not lie entirely above 0, and no component's (tv, dn, wd) interval lies entirely above 0; (b) the non-inferiority margin: the dev-score interval's upper bound is at most +0.05 points; and (c) the estimated saving is at least 5% of the tier's nominal box (estimates below, safe basis). (a) holding but (b) or (c) failing: UNRESOLVED / NOT WORTH IT, shipped behind the switch, off by default. (a) failing: REJECTED for that tier.
rule.reported_beside: per component, view, platform and cohort; names; lines changed; the skip rate (share of frames gated: all, dialogue, wd's finder-cut lines, dn's GRAD crops, per platform); non-blank frames gated; candidate counts of the LM decode

counter_check: report only, deciding nothing: eval/kanum_dev.py's synthetic counter-context set (#109; private renders, the development pool texts) through each tier, today vs gated, greedy and rubi: CER and lines changed. If the gate makes any line of it worse under rubi, the Rubi draft re-reads a line ungated when its greedy text holds a counter context (vocr_post's re-decode looks at blank frames' top-K, which a skipped frame does not offer)

estimates.method: vita/a9_layers.py measure (VitaSDK gcc 15.2, the Vita flags, qemu-arm instruction counts with the plugin's cache model) on ocr-speed's 24 development lines of 60-100 frames (pack $HERD/shared/artifacts/ocr-speed-resume/packs/sub24.bin, sha256 3162151aaf3013f434c5ad7996d04ca2308fe2d3896ce06de14909878906c8b7), --topk 8, each tier's gated blob without and with --gate, --no-pld (the safe basis the tiers are sized on) and with the PLD model; a9_layers.py report --scale 1.000676 (VOCR3-H15's measured 4,942 us per frame, 'the 5.0-5.2 ms per CTC frame', at an assumed 333 MHz); 444 MHz by the clock ratio
estimates.box: est. ms saved per nominal 3-line box (240 frames + 0.1 s finder) and per real box (89 frames, text-stats-boxes), from (i) the pack's own measured per-frame times, and (ii) projected to the development skip rate on console-cut lines (wd) as skip x the measured head cost per frame minus the measured gate cost per frame
estimates.sizes: blob bytes and gate section bytes exact; W8I arena exact with and without the gate (vocr_arena_bytes == train/export.plan_arena); code bytes of vocr.o (VitaSDK -O2 NEON, psp-gcc scalar); all times are estimates, nothing runs on a console
